ranked.headline: Benchmarks shift from single search engines to full DIA quantification pipelines
ranked.summary: Several new JPR studies benchmark DIA search-plus-quantitation combinations on spike-in mixtures and real samples, alongside glycoproteomics and DDA tool comparisons.

ranked.headline: Benchmark and split design, more than architecture, governs binding prediction accuracy
ranked.summary: Cross-state, disordered-partner and cofolding benchmarks, alongside encoder profiling, indicate reported binding accuracy tracks evaluation design as much as model class.

ranked.headline: External references and complementary modalities fill gaps in data-limited cancer prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work fuses methylation atlases, scDNA clones, histopathology and evolutionary features to improve cancer detection, survival and clone assignment.

ranked.headline: Ensemble generators and physics-constrained predictors displace single-structure modeling
ranked.summary: Generative ensemble models, rare-event fingerprints and solvation-aware potentials are reframing structure prediction as sampling distributions with energetics.

ranked.headline: Biomolecular language models get smaller and cheaper as benchmarks expose leakage
ranked.summary: New preprints cut DNA and protein language-model cost via data pruning, learned tokenizers and small backbones, as benchmarks expose homology leakage.

ranked.headline: Serial-section registration and multimodal models extend spatial omics toward volumetric tissue maps
ranked.summary: THiRST rebuilds 3D transcriptomics from serial sections while CORAL, DIRAC and GeneSPOT advance multiscale integration and spatial gene dynamics across conditions and time.

ranked.headline: Models couple transcriptome, chromatin, genome and spatial context to resolve cell-state dynamics
ranked.summary: New preprints link scRNA, scATAC, scHi-C and spatial data via optimal transport, VAEs and transformers, alongside simulators for benchmarking dynamic methods.

ranked.headline: Audits expose evaluation and decoder limits in single-cell perturbation response prediction
ranked.summary: Audits of STATE, GEARS and plate design question perturbation benchmarks while new models add disentanglement, context and measured-experiment memory.

ranked.headline: Learned models rank enzymes, reactions, kinetics and mutants, now tested against stricter benchmarks and wet-lab data
ranked.summary: New work pairs learned enzyme prioritization with reaction-disjoint benchmarks, campaign-grouped kinetic data and experimental screening, including a 150-mutant validation.

ranked.headline: Donor-aware count, covariance and tail models extend population-scale expression analysis beyond mean abundance
ranked.summary: New eQTL, TWAS, fine-mapping and case-control methods model donor structure and count data, with an Alzheimer's atlas of ~4.2M nuclei from 627 donors.

ranked.headline: Open pipelines and curated datasets for modeled protein-ligand complexes and ternary docking
ranked.summary: New docking pipelines and curated structure sets target the data and ensemble-generation bottlenecks in structure-based ligand discovery.

ranked.headline: Proteomics search methods extend to modifications, proteoforms and blind spots in peptide coverage
ranked.summary: Six items reflect pressure on how MS search spaces are defined, from modification combinations to peptide coverage biases, with new models and tools.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models segment and profile cells, organoids and subcellular structures across imaging scales
ranked.summary: New segmentation tools span brightfield organoids, 3D fluorescence and volume EM, alongside graph-network methods for spatial transcriptomics and fMRI.

ranked.headline: LLMs and retrieval pipelines convert literature into structured toxicology and biochemistry databases
ranked.summary: New toxicology tools and two NAR database updates use LLM extraction to build curated resources from literature, alongside a dated-evidence benchmark.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design and context choices are tested as drivers of apparent predictive gains
ranked.summary: Four preprints probe whether time-context, partitioning and feature-view choices, not model architecture, account for reported gains in clinical and CRISPR prediction.

ranked.headline: Somatic variant calling is shifting onto pangenome and germline-composite references
ranked.summary: A benchmark shows pangenomes improve somatic calling over GRCh38, and two preprints apply germline-aware references to long-read somatic SV discovery.

ranked.headline: Generative and screening pipelines add exposure, synthesis and staged filters to evaluation
ranked.summary: New work scores generated molecules by PBPK exposure and multistage filtration, exposing attrition that standard generation metrics miss.

ranked.headline: Structural models are increasingly judged by dynamics and ensembles rather than single static folds
ranked.summary: New benchmarks and tools test predicted structures against MD, bilayer geometry and ensemble behavior, exposing gaps that static metrics miss.

ranked.headline: LLMs are applied to variant reinterpretation, identifiability, and protein design, with limits tested
ranked.summary: Three preprints apply LLMs to biological reasoning tasks and probe their limits, from variant outreach to identifiability to protein design confidence.

ranked.headline: Plant and cross-species databases integrate multi-omics evidence for transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulation
ranked.summary: New database releases and an isoform atlas extend regulatory annotation in plants and model species, spanning miRNAs, cis-regulatory networks, RBP sites and isoform QTLs.

ranked.headline: Single-cell probe quantification and assumption-checked differential expression workflows
ranked.summary: Experimental and analytical omics workflows are being rebuilt with computational tools that report runtime, assumption-compatibility, or randomization safeguards.

ranked.headline: Polymer models infer chromosome folding ensembles and dynamics from Hi-C and epigenomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints use polymer models to recover chromosome ensembles and dynamics from contact and epigenomic data, extending beyond static contact maps.

ranked.headline: Predictive and mechanistic models map bacterial protein and metabolic function at scale
ranked.summary: Sequence-based coevolution and enzyme-constrained metabolic models now predict bacterial interactomes and kinetics across species.

ranked.headline: Isoform-resolved RNA-seq tools dissect splicing, polyadenylation and intronic transcripts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend transcript-level RNA-seq analysis from isolated event calling toward integrated, multi-layer resources.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking predicted structures and design models against physical failure modes
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and design models are now judged against physical and experimental criteria rather than accepted at face value.

ranked.headline: Correcting bias and testing robustness before interpreting genetic association estimates
ranked.summary: Selection-bias correction and restricted-mean pseudo-observations show how association estimates can be stress-tested before they are interpreted.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic methods target million-taxon trees and exact monophyletic partitioning
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method push tree inference toward million-taxon scale and quantum annealing hardware.

ranked.headline: Formal significance testing for spatial domains and scRNA-seq groupings
ranked.summary: Heuristic partitions and feature calls in transcriptomics are being replaced by tests with error control and explicit null models.

ranked.headline: Explicit models of unobserved processes recover gene-level rates and hidden zeros
ranked.summary: Simulation-based and likelihood-based methods now infer gene-level rates and sampling zeros directly rather than absorbing them as noise.

ranked.headline: Compressed colored indexes gain faster updates, queries, and matching statistics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend compact colored indexes to batch updates, SIMD-accelerated search, and move-structure matching on pangenomes.

ranked.headline: Scalable algorithms for pangenome graphs span decomposition, distance, IBD and matching
ranked.summary: Human and terabase-scale assembly collections increasingly require graph-native tools that operate beyond linear reference coordinates.

ranked.headline: Biological latent embeddings gain interpretability and hierarchy-aware structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication couple latent biological embeddings with ontology structure, LLM priors, or feature attribution.

ranked.headline: Computational models link neural dynamics, memory, and sensory input realism
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method paper model neural memory, hierarchical forecasting, and visual segmentation dynamics against experimental data.

ranked.headline: Generative models enable biomedical counterfactuals in simulation and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Counterfactual estimation and agent-level emulation both demand generative or causal models that retain dynamics and adjust for confounders in biomedical data.

ranked.headline: Ligand binding shifts protonation states; metadynamics maps c-MYC drugging pockets
ranked.summary: Recent studies treat bound-state protonation, conformational landscapes, and inhibitor docking as quantitative, computable targets for drug design.

ranked.headline: Likelihood-based inference of noisy stochastic dynamics in microbes, cells and tissues
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published PINN framework address inferring stochastic dynamics from noisy, irregular, or nonsteady biological data.

ranked.headline: Linear-time beam-pruned DP extends RNA accessibility and pseudoknot ensemble analysis
ranked.summary: Beam-pruned dynamic programming now yields linear-time RNA accessibility, opening energy, and pseudoknot ensemble outputs from the same algorithmic framework.

ranked.headline: Damage-aware RY-mer seeds raise aDNA alignment sensitivity over BWA-aln
ranked.summary: Seed-based tools are being redesigned for speed and damage tolerance across ancient DNA, genome similarity, and CRISPR off-target search.

ranked.headline: Protein structure and disorder databases gain machine-accessible APIs and search
ranked.summary: ECOD 2027 and MobiDB 2027 add programmatic access layers, while DaliScope mines DALI structural-alignment sets for biological insight.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free and offline tools advance viral variant detection from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Read-level and offline pipelines now target viral variant calling, abundance estimation and genome recovery with reduced reliance on full alignment or exhaustive search.
